layout.hierarchy: The title/subtitle dominate the top; the large colored network diagram is the visual focus; formulas and notes are smaller supporting text at the bottom.

visual_elements.description: Feedforward neural network with backpropagation error hints. Three horizontal rows and six node columns. Column 1: blue Σ nodes receiving Input Sample and Node Bias. Column 2: red f nodes producing O_i. Column 3: blue Σ nodes labeled Net_j. Column 4: red f nodes labeled O_j. Column 5: yellow Σ nodes labeled Net_k. Column 6: red f nodes labeled O_k. Solid black arrows show forward signal flow left-to-right, including all-to-all connections between adjacent columns. Labels on forward paths include O_i, W_ji, Net_j, O_j, W_jk, Net_k, and O_k. Dashed blue/red arrows show backward error information from Target Label/outputs toward Net_k and earlier layers. Output boxes read Output 1, Output 2, Output m; right-side class labels read Class 1, Class 2, Class m; red vertical Error annotations appear along the error path.
Bottom-left formula panel headed 'For Layer "j"' containing the Net_j and logistic O_j equations.
Bottom-right note panel containing 'Note: Layer "j" is NOT Output Layer'.

typography_notes: Mostly sans-serif, Arial/Calibri-like. Title is bold black and largest; subtitle is bold blue. Diagram labels are small and mostly black, with white symbols inside colored nodes. Formulas use math-style subscripts/superscripts. The word NOT in the note is capitalized for emphasis.
animation_state: Static; no mid-build or partial reveal is evident.
recreation_brief: 1) Use a 16:9 blank slide with a white background. 2) Add a centered title text box at the top: 'Neural Network Model', bold black, about 30-32 pt. 3) Directly below it add the subtitle: '(Effect of Net_k on Calculated Error is known from O/P Layer)', bold blue #0000CC, about 18-20 pt; format Net_k with a subscript k. 4) Add a yellow #FFFF00 oval at the top right with a black outline and the text '17'. 5) Add two pink #FF99CC rounded rectangles with dark pink outlines: 'Input Sample' at the top left and 'Target Label' at the top right. 6) Build the network with three rows and six columns of circles. Approximate column x-centers: 16%, 25%, 34%, 43%, 52%, 61%; row y-centers: 37%, 51%, 65%. Columns 1, 3, 5 are Σ nodes; columns 2, 4, 6 are f nodes. Make columns 1 and 3 blue #0070C0 with white Σ, column 5 yellow #FFFF00 with black Σ, and activation nodes red #FF0000 with white f. Add a pink bias node labeled '1' near the lower left with the label 'Node Bias'. 7) Add solid black forward arrows between nodes, including diagonal all-to-all arrows between adjacent columns. Label the paths with O_i, W_ji, Net_j, O_j, W_jk, Net_k, and O_k using subscripts. 8) Add pale green #CCFFCC output boxes to the right of column 6: 'Output 1', 'Output 2', and 'Output m' with m subscript. Add right-side labels 'Class 1', 'Class 2', and 'Class m'. Add red vertical 'Error' annotations along the error path. 9) Add dashed blue backward arrows from 'Target Label'/outputs toward the Net_k nodes and earlier layers to show that the effect of Net_k is known from the output layer. 10) Under the network add layer markers: 'i' with 'Previous Layer (l)', 'j' with 'Current Layer (You are here)', and 'k' with 'Next Layer (K)'. 11) Add a light gray #F2F2F2 panel at the bottom left headed 'For Layer "j"' and place inside: Net_j = Σ_i (w_ji O_i) and O_j = f(Net_j) = 1/(1+e^{-Net_j}). 12) To the right of that panel add E = 1/2 Σ_j (t_j - O_j)^2 followed by red '✗ ✗ ✗'. Add a bottom-right gray panel with 'Note: Layer "j" is NOT Output Layer'.
